batch.unit: one whole source file: download, verify, retain, adapt, receipt

supersedes.status: historical; preserved unmodified; it executed no bulk fetch

exposure_policy.down_selection: none; final exposure is chosen later by the exact-token quota scheduler (C07) under the frozen tokenizer and the unchanged Mix-01 weights
exposure_policy.reason: oversupply is headroom for C05 drops and exact-count uncertainty; discarding it now would decide exposure before the tokenizer and C05 exist

pending.c05: NOT RUN: global across all Mix-01 source families (dedup before splits, benchmark exclusion over the frozen Mix-01 training pool); deferred until every Mix-01 component has first-pass canonical availability
pending.deterministic_top_up: MAY STILL BE REQUIRED after exact counting: next inventory batches in frozen order under a new reviewed authorization
pending.exact_xlm_token_count: PENDING: estimated tokens only until the tokenizer is frozen
pending.tokenizer: NOT TRAINED: the 32,768-token tokenizer is fitted only after C05, on the training partition

token_method: mix01_inventory: assumed UTF-8 bytes/token 3/4/5; estimated tokens only

verification.accounting: cumulative yield recomputed from the receipts (duplicate, order and plan checks of the campaign accounting)
verification.canonical: every documents.jsonl, compressed rejection ledger and adaptation summary: size and SHA-256 of every byte equal to the receipt
verification.raw: every retained source Parquet: size and SHA-256 of every byte equal to the receipt; identity sidecar equal to the receipt source record
verification.receipts: every unit receipt re-read and checked against its own digest and campaign
verification.staging: no unpublished staging unit and no sealed unit outside a planned batch

views_disjoint: each source row reaches at most one view (row conservation is checked per unit receipt)
